exposure: High-dose oxytocin protocol (40 IU unregulated IV infusion)
Low-dose oxytocin protocol (3 IU bolus + optional 3 IU bolus + 18 IU/h for 1h + 3.6 IU/h for 3h)
outcome: Incidence of postpartum hemorrhage (defined as QBL > 1L)
cohort: The study included 99 healthy parturients undergoing elective cesarean deliveries under neuraxial anesthesia, excluding those with failed labor induction, high-risk pregnancies, general anesthesia, or multiple gestations.
finding: The low-dose oxytocin protocol did not correlate with increased blood loss or a significantly higher incidence of postpartum hemorrhage compared to a high-dose strategy for elective, low-risk cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The low-dose oxytocin protocol used during elective cesarean deliveries did not correlate with increased blood loss or postpartum hemorrhage incidence compared to a high-dose strategy.
